subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Should `readRequestBodyWithLimit` publicly support caller-owned request teardown through `destroyOnError: false`, or should deferred teardown remain private to the Copilot proxy?
rationale: This branch changes an exported plugin-SDK contract and transfers a security- and availability-sensitive socket lifecycle responsibility to callers; code review alone cannot establish whether that is the intended permanent API.

options.title: Approve caller-owned teardown
options.body: Keep the additive option, document that callers must complete the HTTP response and then destroy or drain the request, and add focused lifecycle coverage.

options.title: Keep the SDK contract unchanged
options.body: Implement the bounded Copilot reader locally or through an internal helper so external plugins cannot opt out of the established destruction behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve caller-owned teardown
recommendation.body: Keep the additive option, document that callers must complete the HTTP response and then destroy or drain the request, and add focused lifecycle coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history ties this person to the shared body-reader and plugin SDK contract being changed.
